changelog.notes: Re-froze all 30 snapshots after the fresh 37-brand corpus rebuild and strict source-of-truth audit passed. Every fixture advances output_schema_version 4.2.0->4.3.0. Thirteen products have no other frozen-field change. Fifteen products (182730, 12012, 288344, 278454, 270831, 180417, 18141, 239600, 204571, 241353, 269278, 274498, 298070, 321405, 327416) now fail closed as quality_score_status=not_scored / verdict=NOT_SCORED because a material dose or evidence assessment is unfinished; their previous numeric scores are removed rather than presented as complete. Two already-present maximum-daily exposure findings now propagate correctly: Athletic Pure Pack's niacin exposure and Pure Encapsulations Calcium Magnesium's 450 mg maximum supplemental magnesium exposure exceed their applicable ULs and emit DOSE_OVER_UL_CAUTION; the latter remains scored at 74.1 with verdict CAUTION, while the former is independently quarantined by readiness. Thorne Catalyte moves 71.8->74.6 because the reviewed routing gold set classifies this explicit electrolyte formulation as generic rather than the former prenatal/multivitamin archetype; SAFE status is unchanged. No pillar weights or calibration targets changed, and no production artifact was promoted.

Commit 8b63fd0f intentionally advanced the Stage-3 artifact contract to 4.2.0 while centralizing typed dose-safety and penalty policy. The artifact added dose_safety_evaluation and partial quality-assessment semantics, and the export contract advanced to 2.3.0. The fresh full-corpus run changed only output_schema_version (4.0.0->4.2.0) across these 30 frozen snapshots; quality_score_v4_100, verdict, safety_verdict, flags, grades, coverage, and every other frozen field remained unchanged. Re-frozen all 30 after reviewing the complete diff.

The prior baselines (last frozen at e2583594, the v3-era completion merge) were captured under the retired v3 /80 scorer. Stage 3 has since cut over to the v4 six-pillar producer (refactor f3bed2f2), so EVERY fixture drifted identically and structurally: output_schema_version 3.6.0->4.0.0, score_basis bioactives_scored->v4_six_pillar, evaluation_stage scoring->scored_v4, and the v3-only fields score_80/section_scores/breakdown/supp_type dropped (they do not exist in v4 output). This is the intended, already-shipped v3->v4 cutover, not a scoring regression: v4 is the production scorer (AGENTS.md). Re-frozen all 30 from the current v4 scored output. Added quality_score_v4_100 and quality_score_status to frozen_fields so the gate now pins the canonical v4 score, not only its score_100_equivalent compat mirror. Representative shifts (v3->v4, all shipped v4 numbers): Thorne Vitamin D 72.1->95.0, Iron Bisglycinate 69.2->90.5, Zinc 71.1->86.3 (v4 rewards clean single-ingredient forms); Thorne Catalyte 83.8->71.8, GoL Perfect Food 66.0->50.8 (v4 blend/transparency penalties). Two safety-relevant verdict moves reviewed: 306381 Nutricost PRE SAFE->CAUTION (STIMULANT_CAFFEINE_HIGH_DOSE, correct), 298070 Thorne FloraMend SAFE->POOR (v4 tier label, not a safety block).

sprints_covered: E1.19 enrichment cluster-match hardening (ingredient dedup + min-dose inheritance + abbrev matching + qty>0 gate)
changelog.notes: A5c synergy-bonus dropped from 0.75 to 0.0 on two single-ingredient products (223319 Nutricost KSM-66, 15756 Thorne Vitamin D). Root cause: the previous enricher counted the same product ingredient twice when it substring-matched multiple cluster variants (e.g. ashwagandha matching both 'ashwagandha' and 'ksm-66 ashwagandha' as TWO hits), spuriously crossing match_count>=2 and earning the synergy bonus. E1.19's ingredient-dedup fix correctly counts one hit per product ingredient per cluster. Result: single-ingredient products no longer collect an undeserved synergy bonus. This is a clinically-correct drift — genuine synergy requires ACTUAL multi-ingredient coordination.

Re-froze 17 fixtures after a fresh full 28-brand pipeline run. All 28 brands passed; the other 21 brands produced zero drift, so this is the complete delta set. Each line was reviewed; none are regressions. (1) B5 BLEND DETECTION (9 products: 182730, 288344, 18141, 204571, 241353, 274498, 327416, +): the detector now resolves real named blends with their declared totals and children instead of collapsing them into an anonymous 'General Proprietary Blends' bucket with blend_total_mg=null penalized at the harshest 'none' tier. disclosure_tier now reflects actual label disclosure (none/partial/full) and impact_source moves count_share->mg_share. Net effect is penalty reduction where the label genuinely discloses: 18141 CVS Omega-3 blend is fully disclosed (alpha linolenic acid 50mg of 300mg) -> B5 2.0->0.0; 204571 Organic Adrenal Blend 850mg fully disclosed -> 3.25->0.0. Accuracy correction, not a loosening. (2) A1 MULTIVITAMIN/PRENATAL TRUE-FLOOR (6 products land on 10.8: 288344, 239600, 204571, 241353, 274498, 327416): A1 now uses max(avg, floor) per the SCORING_LOGIC 'floor' spec rather than 0.7*avg+0.3*floor. The repeated 10.8 is the floor. (3) A3 DELIVERY EVIDENCE (18141 1.0->0.0, 321969 2.0->0.0): delivery matches sourced from internal reference notes are no longer trusted; only label-authored evidence (name/fullName, active-ingredient rows, typed DSLD statements) counts. Verified 'bisglycinate' is NOT a listed term in enhanced_delivery.json, so Thorne Iron Bisglycinate (321969) loses previously false-positive tier-2 credit (grade Good->Fair). FOLLOW-UP: enhanced_delivery.json has a genuine vocabulary gap for amino-acid chelates (bisglycinate/glycinate) - the code is correct, the delivery data is incomplete. (4) ROUNDING (293943 score_80 51.5->51.6 only): Python round() is banker's rounding, so 31.95 -> 31.9 while the display showed 32.0 - display and verdict contradicted each other. Now Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP for both consistently. (5) A5/A5b STANDARDIZATION (245156 Goli 1.0->4.0 / 0.0->3.0): standardization credit restored. (6) COSMETIC (298070): activeIngredients[1]->[0] source_path/fingerprint shift from preserving linked display-only blend members; no score change, FloraMend's earlier SAFE->POOR regression is resolved.

Re-froze the complete five-product drift set after a successful fresh 28-brand run. The reviewed enrichment correction now preserves a valid label-based adequacy percentage when the declared unit supports the RDA/AI comparison, while continuing to withhold the UL result when chemical-form lineage is insufficient. This affects Vitamin A reported in mcg RAE, Vitamin E reported in mg, and folate reported in mcg DFE. Unknown Vitamin A/E form and unknown folate lineage still emit indeterminate UL status, pct_ul=null, over_ul=false, and the existing review reason; no safety warning was relaxed. Only the v4 dose pillar changed: 182730 78.8->79.6, 288344 69.1->69.9, 278454 76.8->76.9, 241353 50.8->51.9, and 274498 49.9->50.5. All five retain SAFE verdicts and unchanged non-dose pillars. This is the intended downstream scoring effect of fixing the false 'no reliable intake target' state, not an unreviewed scoring calibration change.

quality_score_v4_100 / score_100_equivalent 69.9 -> 69.5. ONLY these two fields moved: grade (Weak), verdict (SAFE), safety_verdict, mapped_coverage (1.0), quality_score_status, route (multi_or_prenatal / prenatal_multi) and every other fixture field are byte-identical, and the other 31 snapshots showed zero drift. CAUSE NOT ATTRIBUTED — recorded honestly rather than guessed. Two candidates were tested and RULED OUT: (1) the serving_basis daily-servings fix — this product is in that cohort (basis_reason=net_contents_servings_per_container, stored value corrected 0.5 -> 2/day), but re-scoring the current record at BOTH multipliers yields 69.5, so the multiplier is not the driver; (2) PR #53's scoring change — 288344 does not appear in changed_products.csv of the Phase-4 merge ledger. The prior fixture was frozen 2026-07-15 and spans two merged PRs plus a full re-enrichment; the enriched snapshot from that date no longer exists, so a definitive diff is not recoverable. Most likely enrichment-layer drift, which the merge ledger explicitly did not measure (not_measured: re_enrichment_identity_matching). Accepted because the movement is 0.4 points with no tier, safety, verdict, coverage or status change, and is isolated to 1 of 32 fixtures. If this product drifts again, treat the repeat as signal and investigate the enrichment layer rather than re-freezing a second time.
